verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware security key with a CLI and firmware, so a machine-readable spec of its programmatic interface is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.solokeys.dev all returned 404. The solokeys.com llms.txt is a Shopify shopping-agent file, not technical documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
